product_brief.name: FBM curated used-car listings

positive_signals: Vehicle is explicitly offered for sale
Vehicle is clearly shown in real photos
Make, model and year are visible
Location is in a supported province
Useful details such as mileage or transmission are visible
hard_rejections: Listing is sold or no longer available
